text_block_list.text:
Марузенски, accelerating at full throttle,
enjoys
the race and finishes with a good
result.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Riding high on her accomplishment, she
decides
to take another step toward the
Classics by
running in the Spring Stakes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
While Марузенски has been enjoying her
races
with all of her heart...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her incredible running has become like
an
insurmountable wall in the eyes of
other racers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
